scope: Two Gaussian memories, cue transport, accepted witness reports about an earlier event, timing bounds, a well-mixed exchange, selected basin observations and direct applications of the finite-interval existence theorem. The extension checks explicit sensory replay versus a retained episode reference and the same-witness paired reports. Seven additional statements distinguish an exact cue visit from leaving and re-entering a specified cue interval at recorded samples, relate cue distance to Gaussian log odds, and separate cue proximity from the retained episode reference.
open_items: The exact instant of recognition between probes and a population effect of anxious noise.
